text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After putting on a strong performance in 
the Teio Sho, Copano Rickey feels a solid 
sense of progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Feng Shui concept is "Four 
Gods in Harmony." It only becomes truly 
exciting when the Umamusume representing 
the Four Gods gather. Hokko Tarumae's 
presence is simply indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spiritual energy flow connecting Hokko 
Tarumae to her hometown of Tomakomai is 
currently severed. To reconnect it, a race 
in the easily accessible Tohoku region 
would be ideal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship Nambu Hai— Wishing 
for her rival's comeback, she sets her 
next sights on this Tohoku race.
